level: the bench, the section's one level: it holds one Probe, so its whole is that one item
status: The layout spec for the Probe section, the bench, slot P (the Probe bench) of lvgl-switch.md §3, on the LVGL face, opened from Home's Probe module and taking the whole stage: every drawn region names its word or composition, the states docked and away, the bench's focus as data, the events, the bottom line and the strings
note: The one home of the Probe bench numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Probe bench) and its wireframes 11-bench.svg to 11e-bench-nav.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. The bench is the one screen whose subject is a machine: the Probe in its cradle at the left with its Shield plates under it, the mend switch and the upgrade slot in a column at the right. The live screen id is `bench`; its place in frame.json navigation is `probe`.
purpose: Keep the Probe ready for the next expedition: see from the plates alone how whole its Shield is, mend a plate, set whether the dock mends every plate, and fit the upgrade, seeing what it adds. Reads first: the Probe; then its plates

notes.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false; UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29): every event on this screen is a cut to its end, so the host sends hold 0 and runs what follows an event's end (a hand-off, a jump, the next state) on the frame of the key; nothing waits on a still frame. The mend, the switch's slide and the install are cuts to their ends. A press that ends an event with `cut: true` also acts (habitat.json notes.cut); no event here cuts.
notes.subject: the Probe on its work tray, large, is the spotlight, being mended among the device's field tools; its Shield plates under it read the Shield's state with no words. The Probe as the project's Probe art draws it, never a needle
notes.light: the device's warm daylight, one soft key light from the top left, as on every section; the Probe the brightest object. No lab: no cool light, no glass, no clean-room machine
notes.group: the cradle with its plates and the column of two modules form one group centred on x 512 (56 to 968)
notes.plates: the tier's count of plates, never a ghost for a plate the tier does not have (as on Home's Probe module); one table of places a tier, keyed by the tier, centred on the cradle's axis 296; one sprite a place
notes.column: two modules (Home's `module` build, with a lamp): the mend switch, then the upgrade slot. The switch is a standing choice, so it is set at any time; the slot needs the Probe docked
notes.amber: nothing on the bench is amber: a worn plate or an affordable upgrade is a choice, not a need. The lamps are `sprout` (on, ready) or `hairline` (off)
notes.away: while the Probe is out with the Companion the cradle shows empty, so the Probe reads as out, never missing; no plates are drawn

rules.closedList: station-layouts.md, The derived rules (closed): railCompaction slantTabs pageGrid platePosition listPitch splicePlan guideColumns pipGroups leafArc
rules.plates: the plates' places are tables in the spec chosen by the tier (regions.plates.places), data rather than a rule

initial: by the save: the Companion docked, docked; else away
stateRule: docked: the Probe in its cradle with its plates; tier 1 or tier 2 and the slot's arm are props of this state (props.tier, focus.armed). away: the Probe out with the Companion; the cradle empty, no plates. A region with `inStates` exists only in those states

bench.note: the section's ground: the work tray, field tools and small gauges in the device's housing and light; until it lands, Pods' bench stage

cradle.note: the Probe on the tray in its cradle, one painted picture a tier; away, the empty cradle on the tray. The slice keeps rows 0 to 3 empty, as Home's cradle does. Its silhouette is the art director's, inside this box

plates.note: the region is the focus target's box; one sprite a place, 8 px inside its top; nothing else is drawn

knob.move: x 16 → 56 (and back) over 200 ms in whole pixels

plates.off: the first two whole, the rest gone

meaning.rule: the switch's meaning as a picture: the dock, then the plates it leaves whole

adds.rule: what the upgrade adds, as pictures with no digits: three pods carried, four Shield plates, a wider reach, the deep read; the one each adds over tier 1 drawn in its `new` slice

states.dim: docked, tier 1, not affordable, or away: the part dim, the lamp `hairline`
states.ready: docked, tier 1, affordable: the part lit, the lamp `sprout`
states.armed: after the first ✓: the part lifted 8 px out of the socket
states.fitted: tier 2: the part seated, the lamp `sprout`, the adds drawn full

mend.do: the first gone plate from the left seats, gone → whole, over 300 ms (the plate's own two slices, a dither of 16 levels); the counter ticks the price

switch.do: the knob slides from x 16 to 56 (or back) in whole pixels; the plates of the meaning picture and the lamp change at the end

steps.do: the armed part drops 8 px into the socket, whole pixels; the counters tick the price
the cradle's picture cuts to tier 2; the plates move from the tier-1 places to the tier-2 places (a cut), all whole
the fourth plate seats, gone → whole
the adds draw full; the lamp steadies

focus.initial: plates when the Probe is docked and a plate is gone; else switch
focus.primitives: lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1 governs: `order` steps ▲ ▼ through the list as written, skipping ids that are not present, stopping at the ends; nearestIn takes the row nearest the ring

armed.slot: after the first ✓ on a ready slot
armed.clear: any key but ✓ clears the arm; the arm never survives a screen change

focus.held: while events.mend or events.install holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent but room:<x> (kept by the host and dispatched when the hold ends)

vectors.note: the row nearest the plates (centre y 456): the slot (372), not the switch (168)

keys.confirm: does the bottom line's action exactly; the slot arms on the first ✓ and fits the part on the second
keys.back: Home, the ring on Home's Probe module (home.json, ← on a child of Home)

worn.price: ⚡ and its figure (state.PRICE.mend), icon before figure; no price when it costs nothing (the free economy)

short.price: the frame's dimmed cap, the short figure `amber`

bottomLine.notice: the frame's notice only; nothing on the bench sets one

masters.note: every master the bench names, at the size it is shown; none is drawn by the build. No new id; the stage and the three Probe pictures follow the Probe section's look: the work tray in daylight, the Probe lying on it being mended, never a needle, never a lab
list: the lamps at 12: sprout and off
